authority.scope: Prospective repository research using synthetic scenarios, simulated funds, and role-labeled operational records.
authority.evidence: Explicit approval supplied through the authenticated project workspace task.
authority.approvalTextNormalized: for O1 you have all my approval and validation and anything else must be done by yourself

dataScope.amendmentTrigger: Any human participant, personal data, sensitive data, or human-coded outcome requires a new prospective governance and review decision before collection.

responsibleRoles.projectOperator: approves research scope and protocol amendments
responsibleRoles.researchOperator: executes registered protocols and records deviations
responsibleRoles.integrityVerifier: runs the production verifier and independent Rust verifier
responsibleRoles.dataSteward: enforces retention, quarantine, and deletion policy
responsibleRoles.independentReviewer: remains unfilled until an eligible second-person review is recorded

fundingPolicy.rule: No research result may describe simulated funds, fees, blocks, or receipts as financially incurred or publicly finalized.

requirements: compile the complete canonical experiment packet before outcome collection
commit the unchanged packet to an immutable Git ancestor of the execution commit
record the packet path, commit, commit time, and canonical pre-registration hash
commit the same hash through the deterministic in-memory transport before the run enters running
verify the committed packet bytes, commit ancestry, simulated receipt, and run-manifest binding before collection
append prospective amendments under new packet hashes and never overwrite a registered packet
registrationPolicy.claimBoundary: Repository-native registration proves packet identity, ancestry, ordering relative to later committed evidence, and tamper detection within the published repository history. It does not prove an independent timestamp, third-party custody, decentralized persistence, or public-chain finality.

optionalEnhancements: hosted required-check enforcement for release governance
second-person restoration for independent reproducibility evidence
third-party registration or archival timestamping for stronger temporal independence
independent methods, statistics, reproduction, and citation review before venue submission
externalDependencyPolicy.rule: Absence of an optional external enhancement must be disclosed and narrows the corresponding independence claim, but does not block locally executable synthetic experiments whose estimands do not depend on that enhancement.

retentionPolicy.eligibleResearchEvidence: retain indefinitely with immutable manifests and checksums
retentionPolicy.developmentPayloads: eligible for purge after 30 days while metadata, manifests, receipts, and audit logs remain
retentionPolicy.accidentalSensitiveMaterial: quarantine immediately, exclude from research, and delete after incident documentation

claimBoundary: This decision authorizes a synthetic, simulation-funded, repository-native study. It is not institutional ethics approval, third-party registration, independent review, an independent timestamp, or evidence that any public-chain transaction occurred.
